title: Glif Launches Tool to Create Commercials Using Hundreds of AI Models
summary:
The AI platform has introduced a new service that lets users generate advertisements and promotional materials by selecting virtual human representations from a specialized library. The tool, which Glif describes as an integrated modeling agency, allows users to upload product briefs to produce marketing content end to end.

Fabian Stelzer, who helped launch the feature, said that the tool's capabilities allowed for the production of the agency's launch video in less than 2 hours. The service is now available to users within the Glif interface.
